name: Streets Of Gold
overview: Scripture reveals that earthly wealth, such as silver and gold, cannot save or satisfy the soul, especially in the day of God's wrath, highlighting the futility of trusting in material riches (Ezekiel 7:19). In contrast, the promise of a prepared eternal home with Christ, where believers will dwell in the new Jerusalem—a city of God coming down from heaven—is assured to those who overcome (John 14:3; Revelation 3:12). This eternal reality is characterized by the absence of sorrow, pain, and death, as God will wipe away all tears, ushering in a new heaven and new earth where former things have passed away (Revelation 21:1,4). True value is found not in earthly treasures but in the eternal presence and provision of God.
